Thanks again for everything.

What?! You're foolish...
Please, leave me alone. I'm sure the walls never used to sway that much.

That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh yeah!

stages.label: free_jeremy_servil
hints: Wow! Please set me free, then we can find my dad. I overheard a guard talking. I think they've taken him to the arena.

stages.label: general_khazard_belong_nobody
hints: Well, I suppose we could find some arrangement for their freedom... hmmm?
I'll let them go, but you must stay and fight for me. You'll make me double the gold if you manage to last a few fights.
Guards! Take him to the cells.

stages.label: general_khazard_attack
hints: You however have caused me much trouble today. You must remain here so that I may at least have the pleasure of killing you myself.

stages.label: king_arthur_firstmeet
hints: Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur.
Well then you must complete your quest to rescue Merlin. Talk to my knights if you need any help.
Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy.

stages.label: sir_gawain
hints: The Grail? That is truly a noble quest indeed. None but Galahad have come close.
He used to be one of the Knights of the Round Table, but he mysteriously disappeared many years ago.
That is a good question.

stages.label: sir_lancelot
hints: Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?
You got lucky with freeing Merlin but there's no way a puny wannabe like you is going to find the Holy Grail where so many others have failed.
Hmmm. I heard you freed Merlin. Either you're better than you look or you got lucky. I think the latter.

stages.label: lefaye_spare_son
hints: STOP! Please... spare my son.
You have guessed correctly that I'm responsible for that.
I suppose I can live with that fool Merlin being loose for the sake of my son.

stages.label: bat_bones
hints: GRAAAAAARGH!
GRAAAAAARGH!
Thou hast me in thine control. So that I mayst return from whence I came, I must grant thee a boon. What dost thou wish of me?

stages.label: merlins_crystal
hints: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!
It's not fun being trapped in a giant crystal!
Go speak to King Arthur, I'm sure he'll reward you!

Unfortunately, I've forgotten to buy some of the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. I don't suppose you could help me?

hints: I thank you greatly adventurer! Also... if you find Caleb... please... let him know his father still loves him....

stages.label: caleb_fitzharmon_bit
hints: Well, I am the oldest son, so by the rules of chivalry, I am most entitled to be rightful bearer of the crest.
Well that is true... perhaps it is time to put my pride aside... I'll tell you what: I'm struggling to complete this fish salad of mine,
so if you will assist me in my search for the ingredients, then I will let you take my piece as reward for your assistance.

stages.label: caleb_fitzharmon_fish
hints: How is the fish collecting going?
Remember, I want the following cooked fish: Swordfish, Bass, Tuna, Salmon, and Shrimp.

stages.label: caleb_fitzharmon_rest
hints: Well... my brothers and I had a slight disagreement about it... we all wanted to be heir to my fathers' lands, and we each ended up with a piece of the crest.
None of us wanted to give up our rights to our brothers, so we didn't want to give up our pieces of the crest, but none of us wanted to face our father by
returning to him with an incomplete crest... We each went our seperate ways many years past, none of us seeing our father or willing to give up our fragments.

stages.label: gem_trader_crest
hints: Fitzharmon eh? Hmmm.... If I'm not mistaken that's the family name of a member of the Varrockian nobility. You know, I HAVE seen someone of that
persuasion around here recently... Wearing a poncey yellow cape he was! Came in here all la-di-dah, high and mighty, asking for jewelry made
from 'perfect gold' - whatever that is - like 'normal' golds just not good enough for little lord fancy pants there! I told him to head to the desert

stages.label: crest_man_avan
hints: Then you have found him. My name is Avan Fitzharmon.
Ha! I suppose one of my worthless brothers has sent you on this quest then?
My... my father wishes this? Then that is a different matter. I will let you have my crest shard, adventurer, but you must first do something for me.

stages.label: boot_the_dwarf_gold
hints: High quality gold eh? Hmmm... Well, the very best quality gold that I know of, is just East of the large city Ardougne, underground somewhere.
I don't believe it's exactly easy to get to though...

stages.label: avan_jewelry
hints: So how are you doing getting me my perfect gold jewelry?
These... these are exquisite! EXACTLY what I was searching for all of this time! Please, take my crest fragment!
Now, I suppose you will be wanting to find my brother Johnathon who is in possession of the final piece of the family's crest?

stages.label: johnathon_fitzharmon_intro
hints: That... I am...
The.. poison.. it is all.. too much... My head... will not... stop spinning...

stages.label: johnathon_fitzharmon
hints: I'm feeling alright now, thanks.

The trolls have taken up camp on Death Plateau! They are using it to launch raids at night on the village. We have tried to attack the camp but the main path is heavily guarded!
If there is another way I do not know of it.

stages.label: eohric_guard
hints: There was only one guard on last night. Harold. He's a nice lad, if a little dim.
Harold is staying at the Toad and Chicken.

stages.label: harold_duty
hints: I said I don't want to talk about it!
Yeah.
I don't want to talk about it!

stages.label: death_headservant
hints: Hi, can I help?
Yes, if you buy Harold a beer he might talk to you. I also know he has a weakness for gambling. Hope that helps!
Hmm. Harold has got in trouble a few times over his drinking and gambling. Perhaps he'd open up after a drink?

stages.label: harold_drink
hints: What?
I fink I've had enough!

stages.label: haroldgamble_end

Delrith will come forth from the stone circle again.

One I gave to Rovin, the captain of the palace guard.

Who disturbs the rocks of Zekin?

Come back when you do.

stages.label: aubury
hints: My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. I notice that you brought the head wizard a special talisman that was the key to our finally unlocking the puzzle.
Combined with the information I had already already collated regarding the Rune Essence, I think we have finally unlocked the power to
...no. I am getting ahead of myself. Please take this summary of my research back to the head wizard at the Wizards' Tower. I trust his judgement on whether to let you in on our little secret or not.

stages.label: seer_looking_glass
hints: Let me look into my looking glass.
I can see a scorpion that you seek. It would appear to be near some nasty spiders. I can see two coffins there as well.
The scorpion seems to be going through some crack in the wall. It's gone into some sort of secret room.

stages.label: seer_first_scorp
hints: Well, I've checked my looking glass. There seems to be a kharid scorpion in a little village in the east, surrounded by lots of uncivilised-looking warriors. Some kind of merchant there seems to have picked it up.
That's all I can tell you about that scorpion.
It's good that you should ask. I have information on the last scorpion for you.

stages.label: caroline_help
hints: Is there any chance you could help me?
It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.
They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.

stages.label: holgart_wantboat
hints: Hello m'hearty.
I'm afraid it isn't sea worthy, it's full of holes. To fill the holes I'll need some swamp paste.
Yes, swamp tar mixed with flour and heated over a fire.

stages.label: holgart_paste
hints: Hello m'hearty. Did you manage to make some swamp paste?
It's simply swamp tar mixed with flour heated over a fire. Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.
I can't fix my row boat without it.

stages.label: kennith_chat
hints: No, I want my daddy!
He went to get help days ago.
The nasty fishermen tried to throw me and daddy into the sea. So he told me to hide here.

stages.label: holgart_something_strange
hints: You're telling me, none of the sailors seem to remember who I am.
That's a worry, no-one's heard from him on shore. Come on, we'd better go look for him.

stages.label: kent
hints: Oh my, I must get back to shore.
Oh thank Saradomin! I thought I'd be left out here forever.
I knew the row boat wasn't sea worthy. I couldn't risk bringing him along but you must get him off that platform.

hints: Ok I'll see you when you have some wool.

stages.label: halgrive_i_can_do_that_for_you
hints: Y-you will??? That is excellent news! Head to the enclosure we have set up on Farmer Brumty's land to the north of the city; the four infected sheep should still be somewhere in that vicinity.
Before you will be allowed to enter the enclosure, however, you must ensure you have some kind of protective clothing to prevent contagion.
Doctor Orbon wears it when conducting mercy missions to the infected parts of the city. You should be able to find him in the chapel just north of here.

stages.label: doctor_orbon_purchase_plague_outfit
hints: That's ok. Just don't go near those sheep. When you can find the money come back here.
These should protect you from infection.

stages.label: squire_thing_is
hints: The thing is, this sword is a family heirloom. It has been passed down through Vyvin's family for five generations! It was originally made by the Imcando dwarves, who were
a particularly skilled tribe of dwarven smiths. I doubt anyone could make it in the style they do.
I'm not a hundred percent sure the Imcando tribe exists anymore. I should think Reldo, the palace librarian in Varrock, will know; he has done a lot of research on the races of RuneScape.

stages.label: reldo_imcando_dwaves
hints: The Imcando dwarves, you say?
Ah yes... for many hundreds of years they were the world's most skilled smiths. They used secret smithing knowledge passed down from generation to generation.
Unfortunately, about a century ago, the once thriving race was wiped out during the barbarian invasions of that time.

stages.label: thurgo_redberry_pie
hints: I'd never say no to a redberry pie! They're GREAT stuff!
By Guthix! THAT was good pie! Anyone who makes pie like THAT has got to be alright!

stages.label: thurgo_special_sword_post_pie
hints: Well, after bringing me my favorite food I guess I should give it a go. What sort of sword is it?
A Knight's sword eh? Well I'd need to know exactly how it looked before I could make a new one.
All the Faladian knights used to have swords with unique designs according to their position. Could you bring me a picture or something?

stages.label: squire_status_report
hints: A picture eh? Hmmm.... The only one I can think of is in a small portrait of Sir Vyvin's father... Sir Vyvin keeps it in a cupboard in his room I think.
Please don't let him catch you! He MUSTN'T know what happened!
Please hurry!

stages.label: thurgo_about_sword
hints: Have you got a picture of the sword for me yet?
Well, come back when you do.
Ok. You'll need to get me some stuff in order for me to make this.

stages.label: tbwt_timfraku_starttbwt
hints: Thank you very much. I shall reward you greatly if you succeed.
We shall see, Bwana.

stages.label: tbwt_tamayu_slayed_shaikahan
hints: I did it! I, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku, did slay the Shaikahan!
The deaths of my kin have been avenged. You are my witness.
Yes. Go on ahead without me. I have further matters to attend to here.

hints: Best of luck with that adventurer.

stages.label: rpdt_employee
hints: Welcome to RPDT!
Well... I guess we could do it now...
We're the premier delivery service in ALL of RuneScape!

hints: Congratulations, human!
Well hello stranger. My name's Bolren, I'm the king of the tree gnomes.

stages.label: denulth_troll
hints: We are busy preparing for an attack by night. Godric knows of a secret entrance to the stronghold. Once we destroy the stronghold Burthorpe will be safe! Friend, we are indebted to you!
I'm afraid I have bad news. We made our attack as planned, but we met unexpected resistance.
We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request; we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.

stages.label: troll_free_godric
hints: Thank you, my friend.

stages.label: koftik_first_dialogue
hints: That I am, brave adventurer. King Lathas informed me that you need to cross these mountains.
I'm afraid you'll have to go through the ancient underground pass...
These caves are different... They're filled with the spirit of Zamorak!

stages.label: upassdwarf1
hints: Back away! Back away! ....Wait. ...You're human!

Ha ha, listen up. We came here as miners decades ago, completely unaware of the evil that lurked here. There's no way through, not while Iban still rules. He controls the gateway, the only way to the other side.
It once stood as the 'Well of Voyage'. A gateway to the West. Now Iban's moulded it into a pit of the damned, a portal to Zamorak's darkest realms.

stages.label: brundt_very_interested
hints: You would? These are unusual sentiments to hear from an outerlander! My suggestion was going to be that if you crave adventure and battle,
and your heart sings for glory, then perhaps you would be interested in joining our clan, and becoming a Fremennik yourself?
Well, there are two ways to become a member of our clan and call yourself a Fremennik: be born a Fremennik, or be voted in by our council of elders.

sources.note: stages from varp assignments, rewards from the completion block

stages.label: warrior_if_hidden
hints: Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.
Of course we know! We just haven't found which tree the stupid leprechaun's hiding in yet!
GAH! I didn't mean to tell you that! Look, just forget I said anything okay?

stages.label: zanarisleprechaun_dramenwood_staff
hints: Oh, was I fergetting to say? Yer need to be carrying a Dramenwood staff to be getting there! Otherwise Yer'll just be ending up in the shed.
Dramenwood staffs are crafted from branches of the Dramen tree, so they are. I hear there's a Dramen tree over on the island of Entrana in a cave
or some such. There would probably be a good place for an elephant like yer to be starting looking I reckon.

stages.label: trufitus_searchfor
hints: What?! You must be crazy! That place has passed into myth and legend, it has been buried under rubble for years. It's most likely buried 20 men deep, and that's if you can actually find it.
Are you sure you're going to go and look for it? I may be able to do some research into this if you agree. Only I don't want to waste my time if you're not serious about this!

Ok then Bwana, good luck with your quest, and remember to stock up well with adventuring supplies before setting off. You never know how useful some fairly ordinary things might be when you're adventuring.

stages.label: trufitus
hints: Greetings! I hope things are going well for you now. I have no new information since last we spoke. Needless to say, that if something does come up I will certainly get in touch directly.
Hello again Bwana! Well Done again for helping to defeat Rashiliyia. Hopefully things will return to normal around here now.
Hello Bwana. I conclude that you have been successful. Mosol sent word that the village is clearing of zombies. You have done us all a great deed!
